articles.summary: American companies are being targeted by foreign spies, ransomware groups and even fake job applicants from North Korea. One cybersecurity firm speaks out about the threats they're seeing and how they're combating them.
articles.title: How the cybersecurity industry is trying to keep up with foreign threat actors

articles.summary: The security firm said the operatives who tried to breach it turned out to be responsible for cyberattacks on dozens of critical infrastructure organizations worldwide.
articles.title: SentinelOne rebuffs China-linked attack — and discovers global intrusions
